title: openssh is being blocked by (among otherthings) mrbayes, which can't possibly pass on s390x, as its dependency, libhmsbeagle, depends on mesa-opencl-icd | opencl-icd, neither of which is installable on s390x. This makes mrbayes fail on that architecture
description: openssh is being blocked by (among otherthings) mrbayes, which can't possibly pass on s390x, as its dependency, libhmsbeagle, depends on mesa-opencl-icd | opencl-icd, neither of which is installable on s390x. This makes mrbayes fail on that architecture
diff:
diff --git a/ubuntu-release b/ubuntu-release
index b4ab9b9..00ff50d 100644
--- a/ubuntu-release
+++ b/ubuntu-release
@@ -57,3 +57,7 @@ force-badtest gcc-16/all/riscv64
 # adios4dolfinx test also runs with python3.15 where python3-mpi4py has no
 # extension yet (python3.15-add), unblock fenics-dolfinx and the spdlog transition
 force-badtest adios4dolfinx/all/i386
+
+# Uninstallable on s390x due to a missing dependency (libhmsbeagle needs one of mesa-opencl-icd or opencl-icd,
+# neither of which is on s390x), blocking migration of openssh
+force-badtest mrbayes/3.2.7a-7build3/s390x
